name: Gasthof Weberbauer
beschreibung:
Centrally located in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, the historic Weberbauer charms visitors with cosy guestrooms and renowned regional culinary tradition. It is a wonderful year-round destination.

The Scheffau cable car accessing SkiWelt, Lake Hintersteiner See, and hiking trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: The traditional Gasthof Weberbauer in Scheffau provides authentic Tyrolean inn charm in the village center.
